blocks.text: Nitric oxide (NO) aur nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) jaisi gases ko mil kar NOₓ likha jata hai. Yeh aam taur par fossil fuels jalne se banti hain. NOₓ in chemical reactions se banti hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Fuel mein nitrogen bohat kam hoti hai. Engine ke andar ka bohat zyada temperature khud hawa ki nitrogen aur oxygen ko mila deta hai (N₂ + O₂ → 2NO). Phir NO hawa ki oxygen se mil kar NO₂ ban jati hai.

N₂O (nitrous oxide) ke natural sources mitti aur samandar ke microbial processes hain, jahan bacteria nitrogen wale compounds ko torte hain. Insani sources mein zaraat (agriculture, yani synthetic fertilizers) aur industrial processes (fossil fuels ka jalna) shamil hain. N₂O ozone layer ko kam (deplete) karti hai. N₂O ki barhti miqdar climate change mein hissa dalti hai aur hawa ke mayar (air quality) ko bhi kharab kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Fuel jalane se nitrogen oxides kyun bante hain jabke fuel mein nitrogen bohat kam hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Jalne ka bohat zyada temperature hawa ki apni nitrogen aur oxygen ko mila deta hai: N₂ + O₂ → 2NO. Phir nitric oxide exhaust aur hawa mein oxidise ho kar NO₂ ban jati hai: 2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂.

items: NOₓ = NO + NO₂, fuel jalne se: N₂ + O₂ → 2NO (high temp); 2NO + O₂ → 2NO₂.
N₂O bacteria, fertilizers aur jalne se; ozone layer kam karti hai aur climate change barhati hai.
